Hi Vanessa —

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. The SIG intake team had a few follow-ups on identity and access controls we need to close out for our internal review: 

- SAML/SSO: canonical SP metadata (xml) and confirmation that IdP-initiated and SP-initiated flows are supported. Also need statement on session timeout defaults and support for timely session invalidation after account deprovisioning.
- SCIM: attribute mapping export (CSV) showing which attributes Redwood writes (externalId, userName, emails, groups) and the behaviour for overwrites vs. push-only provisioning.
- RBAC: role inventory for admin/owner/editor/viewer roles and the minimum permissions tied to each (we want to validate least-privilege for our SOC reviewer).
- MFA: confirmation whether MFA is enforced for admin/owner roles when SSO is used (we'd like the policy doc and an example enforcement log).

Could you share these items (or a consolidated zip) by end of day Monday (Nov 9)? If it's easier, point us to a Drive folder and we'll pull from there.

Appreciate it — Samira (Poppy Financial)

Vanessa / Samira —

I've attached the SP metadata XML and added a short note below about session handling.

Attachment: saml-metadata.xml (saml metadata, includes ACS URL and cert thumbprint)

Notes:
- Redwood supports both SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows.
- Session timeout default: 8 hours for interactive sessions; configurable per-tenant via console.
- Deprovisioning: when a SCIM delete event is received, sessions for that user are flagged for revocation and a background job clears long-lived refresh tokens within 5 minutes (we can produce an audit trace).

If you want the raw SAML logs for a sample user, say the word and I'll include a redacted snippet.

All —

I've exported the SCIM attribute mapping CSV and included a short explanation of a small mapping nuance we saw in Poppy's test tenant: Redwood writes the following attributes by default: externalId, userName, name.givenName, name.familyName, emails[type=work], groups. We do not overwrite userName on subsequent updates unless the SCIM patch explicitly sets userName; this preserves upstream canonical IDs.

Attachment: scim-mapping.csv

Note on groups: we sync group membership via the /Groups endpoint; group deletions in the IdP are applied as remove operations in Redwood.

If you want, I can also produce a CSV showing a sample delta (create/update/delete) for a batch provisioning run.

Thanks —
Karthik
